item.title: Could Jed York lose control of the 49ers after NFL punishment looms?
item.summary: Jed York’s future as San Francisco 49ers owner is under scrutiny after he pleaded no contest to misdemeanor charges in Ohio. The NFL is reviewing the case under its personal conduct policy, leaving open the possibility of discipline. Legal experts say owners can face suspension or, in extreme cases, separation from the league. However, York’s removal is not automatic, and the NFL must first investigate the circumstances before deciding his fate.
